name: ankurjain-skills
description: Claude Code skills by Ankur Jain

plugins.name: hoop
plugins.description: Review what Claude writes the way you review code: hoop's MCP server, a skill for building a document together, and hooks for plan review, pull requests and the Work view

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: End-of-session retrospective that turns this session's corrections, dead ends and decisions into concise, correctly placed instructions so future sessions spend fewer tokens

plugins.name: update-stack
plugins.description: Update every pinned version in a repo (dependencies, build plugins, wrappers, CI actions, container images, language runtime) to its latest stable release, keep each consistent everywhere it appears, and verify nothing broke

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Create a new agent skill or improve an existing one: dedup against existing skills, pick the right placement, write to the official authoring rules, test with and without the skill, review against a checklist, and package for a plugin marketplace

plugins.name: devloop
plugins.description: A development loop from request to small, tested, reviewed pull requests, where every decision and approval goes to a person through hoop
